resources.string: When tracking needs your attention, for example a missing permission.
This app shares your location with Dispatch while you have an accepted load, even with your screen locked. Keep using the Driver Portal for everything else.
In the Driver Portal, open Settings → Phone tracking and tap Set up phone tracking. Enter the 8-character code it shows.
Test build: use http://localhost:5000 with adb reverse, or http://<your PC\'s address>:5000.
The server address must start with https://.
The server address must start with http:// or https://.
Couldn\'t reach Suprah. Check your internet connection and try again.
Dispatch needs to approve this phone before your location is shared. Keep this screen open: Start on duty unlocks by itself as soon as they do. If it\'s taking long, ask your dispatcher.
Tap Start on duty at the start of your day. Your location is only shared while you have an accepted load.
Dispatch can follow your trip. You can lock your screen or use other apps.
Location is paused. It starts by itself when you accept a load.
You can start once Dispatch approves this phone.
